mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) as originalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(discount_amount), 0) as totalDiscount, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(AVG(actual_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT t1.date, t1.sales, t1.orderCount, t1.avgOrderAmount, COALESCE(t1.sales - COALESCE(t2.totalCost, 0), 0) as profit FROM ( /* 子查询1：从订单表统计销售数据 */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(AVG(actual_amount), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 AND DATE(created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( /* 子查询2：从订单项表统计成本 */ SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ro.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) as totalCost FROM restaurant_order ro INNER JOIN restaurant_order_item roi ON ro.id = roi.order_id INNER JOIN dish d ON roi.dish_id = d.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND DATE(ro.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(ro.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ro.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ) t2 ON t1.date = t2.date ORDER BY t1.date ASC

SELECT period_type, CASE period_type WHEN 1 THEN '早餐' WHEN 2 THEN '午餐' WHEN 3 THEN '下午茶' WHEN 4 THEN '晚餐' ELSE '夜宵' END as periodName, CASE period_type WHEN 1 THEN '06:00-10:00' WHEN 2 THEN '10:00-14:00' WHEN 3 THEN '14:00-17:00' WHEN 4 THEN '17:00-21:00' ELSE '21:00-06:00' END as timeRange, sales, orderCount FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 6 AND HOUR(created_at) < 10 THEN 1 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 10 AND HOUR(created_at) < 14 THEN 2 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 14 AND HOUR(created_at) < 17 THEN 3 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 17 AND HOUR(created_at) < 21 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END as period_type, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY CASE WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 6 AND HOUR(created_at) < 10 THEN 1 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 10 AND HOUR(created_at) < 14 THEN 2 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 14 AND HOUR(created_at) < 17 THEN 3 WHEN HOUR(created_at) >= 17 AND HOUR(created_at) < 21 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END ) t ORDER BY period_type

SELECT CASE status WHEN 1 THEN '已下单' WHEN 2 THEN '已接单' WHEN 3 THEN '制作中' WHEN 4 THEN '制作完成' WHEN 5 THEN '已完成' WHEN 6 THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END as statusName, status as statusCode, COUNT(*) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY status ORDER BY status

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelledOrderCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (1, 2, 3, 4) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processingOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 THEN actual_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 THEN discount_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalDiscount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 THEN actual_amount ELSE NULL END), 0) as avgOrderAmount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND created_at >= #{startTime} AND created_at <= #{endTime}

SELECT d.id as dishId, d.dish_name as dishName, d.category_id as categoryId, dc.category_name as categoryName, d.dish_pics as dishPic, d.cost_price as costPrice, d.stock as stock, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 1 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.discount_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalDiscount FROM dish d LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON d.category_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN restaurant_order_item roi ON d.id = roi.dish_id LEFT JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id WHERE d.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.created_at >= #{startTime} AND ro.created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY d.id, d.dish_name, d.category_id, dc.category_name, d.dish_pics, d.cost_price, d.stock HAVING salesQuantity > 0 ORDER BY salesAmount DESC, salesQuantity DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ro.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND roi.dish_id = #{dishId} AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND DATE(ro.created_at) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(ro.created_at) <= #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ro.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE_FORMAT(ro.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ASC

SELECT d.id as dishId, d.dish_name as dishName, dc.category_name as categoryName, d.dish_pics as dishPic, d.stock as stock, d.created_at as createdAt, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity), 0) as salesLast30Days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmountLast30Days, MAX(ro.created_at) as lastSaleTime FROM dish d LEFT JOIN dish_category dc ON d.category_id = dc.id LEFT JOIN restaurant_order_item roi ON d.id = roi.dish_id LEFT JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.created_at >= #{startTime} AND ro.created_at <= #{endTime} WHERE d.store_id = #{storeId} AND d.sale_status = 1 GROUP BY d.id, d.dish_name, dc.category_name, d.dish_pics, d.stock, d.created_at HAVING salesLast30Days <= 10 ORDER BY salesLast30Days ASC, salesAmountLast30Days ASC

SELECT dc.id as categoryId, dc.category_name as categoryName, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity), 0) as salesQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.total_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesAmount, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) as totalCost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 1 THEN roi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as giftQuantity, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN roi.is_gift = 0 THEN roi.discount_price ELSE 0 END), 0) as totalDiscount, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.id) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order_item roi INNER JOIN restaurant_order ro ON roi.order_id = ro.id INNER JOIN dish d ON roi.dish_id = d.id INNER JOIN dish_category dc ON d.category_id = dc.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND ro.created_at >= #{startTime} AND ro.created_at <= #{endTime} GROUP BY dc.id, dc.category_name HAVING salesQuantity > 0 ORDER BY salesAmount DESC

SELECT #{year} as year, t1.month, t1.monthName, t1.sales, COALESCE(t1.sales - COALESCE(t2.totalCost, 0), 0) as profit, t1.orderCount, CASE WHEN t1.sales > 0 THEN ROUND((t1.sales - COALESCE(t2.totalCost, 0)) / t1.sales * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END as profitRate FROM ( /* 子查询1：从订单表统计销售数据 */ SELECT MONTH(created_at) as month, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') as monthName, COALESCE(SUM(actual_amount), 0) as sales, COUNT(*) as orderCount FROM restaurant_order WHERE store_id = #{storeId} AND payment_status = 1 AND status != 6 AND YEAR(created_at) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(created_at), DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m') ) t1 LEFT JOIN ( /* 子查询2：从订单项表统计成本 */ SELECT MONTH(ro.created_at) as month, COALESCE(SUM(roi.quantity * d.cost_price), 0) as totalCost FROM restaurant_order ro INNER JOIN restaurant_order_item roi ON ro.id = roi.order_id INNER JOIN dish d ON roi.dish_id = d.id WHERE ro.store_id = #{storeId} AND ro.payment_status = 1 AND ro.status != 6 AND YEAR(ro.created_at) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(ro.created_at) ) t2 ON t1.month = t2.month ORDER BY t1.month ASC
